instruction: Cache the pip download directory keyed on requirements.txt with actions/cache@v4.
output:
name: pip-cache
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest

instruction: Use the built-in pip cache option of actions/setup-python@v5 instead of a manual cache step.
output:
name: setup-python-cache
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest

instruction: Cache the local Maven repository at ~/.m2/repository for a Java build.
output:
name: maven-cache
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
      - run: mvn -B -ntp verify

instruction: Cache the C++ compiler cache directory so repeated builds reuse object files.
output:
name: ccache
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ccache
          key: ccache-${{ hashFiles('**/*.{c,cc,cpp,h}') }}
          restore-keys: ccache-
      - run: cmake -B build -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache && cmake --build build

instruction: Configure restore-keys fallback so a partial cache can be reused when the lockfile changes.
output:
name: restore-keys
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            modules-${{ runner.os }}-
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build

instruction: Upload the build output as an artifact that is kept for 7 days.
output:
name: artifact-retention
on: push
jobs:
  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: build/
          retention-days: 7

instruction: Download the artifact produced by the build job in a separate test job that depends on it.
output:
name: artifact-handoff
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app
          path: dist/
  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app
          path: dist/
      - run: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh dist/

instruction: Upload a test report artifact even when the test step fails, warning if no files match.
output:
name: artifact-warn
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pytest --junitxml=report.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-report
          path: report.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn

on: push
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-${{ hashFiles('package.json') }}
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: npx playwright test

instruction: Split a build across two jobs where the first uploads compiled files and the second bundles them.
output:
name: two-job-artifacts
on: push
jobs:
  compile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make compile
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: compiled
          path: out/
  bundle:
    needs: compile
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: compiled
          path: out/
      - run: tar -czf bundle.tar.gz out/ && ls -lh bundle.tar.gz
